unit.explanation: Units are 54 LCOs (patient-regimen instances) from 36 patients, each with matched clinical and LCO-DST results

readout.explanation: LCO sensitivity is measured as ratio of treated/untreated ATP luminance (viability)

direction.explanation: Lower viability ratio indicates higher LCO sensitivity to treatment

threshold_rule.explanation: Cutoff was determined via ROC analysis to discriminate clinical response

threshold_timing.explanation: ROC optimization used the same 54-unit evaluation cohort

patient_mapping.explanation: Individual LCO-DST and clinical response are linked for each unit

regimen_match.explanation: Clinical regimens were identical to LCO-DST test regimens for all included units

n_units.explanation: Total of 54 LCOs included in the accuracy analysis: 21+5+4+24 = 54

split.explanation: Analysis performed on a single real-world cohort, no independent test split

notes: Accuracy calculation: (21 + 24) / 54 = 45 / 54 = 0.8333333333333334, matching the reported value.
Confusion matrix: TP=21, FN=4, FP=5, TN=24 per supp.pdf page 4.
